title: HVT escort of sealed 'mystery boxes' on classified flights

tellings.quote: these targets most of the time were like sealed containers. Um, we called them mystery boxes.

plain: In the 1990s, according to a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, he escorted what the military calls high-value targets on classified flights, and most of the time those targets were sealed containers. He tells Michels from his own experience that the crews called them "mystery boxes," which would mean the people moving the cargo were not told what it was.
